# Welcome to the Board board (Claude Code CLI local)

## 1. What the board does
- Columns: **`todo`** (for you to do), **`question`** (choices for you), **`info`** (reports & news), and **`done`** (finished).
- Commenting under any post reaches the agent that wrote it and replies come back in that thread; `question` posts support one-tap answers; priorities run `P1`–`P3`.
- The **"Where we are"** card at the top tracks every workstream, and this **`_orchestrator`** thread ("Ask the orchestrator") is for anything not tied to one post.

## 2. How this runtime works (`claude-cli`)
- **Local board + phone access:** served by `board_server.py` at `http://127.0.0.1:8765` with Tailscale/PWA access (Android Private DNS / NextDNS users: use the direct Tailscale IP link if `*.ts.net` does not resolve).
- **One-word launcher:** type `board` in any terminal to start the board, print your link, and open Claude Code (`claude --permission-mode auto`) as the orchestrator, with `kit_guard.py` guarding every command (destructive commands stay blocked); `board --agy` opens agy instead.
- **Live forwarding & parallel workers:** a background listener wakes the orchestrator (0 tokens while waiting) on your comments, 👍 Likes, and tapped answers and passes them to the part that wrote the post; parts run as subagents in their own git worktrees.
- **Warm Git sync:** `kit.py receive` / `kit.py publish` sync board state cleanly with other runtimes.

## 3. Everything open now
- **Claude Code CLI runtime (the kit run by Claude Code, tested on its own board)** (`P1`): CL8 design principles complete + no emoji Like, then CL9 breaks, then CL10 see the new UI work

## 4. Setup & runners
- Local `computer` runner is ready out of the box in this Claude Code session (listener active, worktree subagents available).

## 5. What can run now
- **Claude Code CLI runtime (the kit run by Claude Code, tested on its own board)** (`P1`): CL8 design principles complete + no emoji Like, then CL9 breaks, then CL10 see the new UI work

A 👍 on this message launches them all; or tell me which.
